section-143-1.FOR: The county court or the sheriff
section-143-1.TO: make an order for a term to be removed or modified
section-143-1.ON: an application by a person who has an interest in a contract or other agreement which includes a term that is unenforceable as a result of section 142

section-143-2.UNLESS: every person who would be affected by it— (a) has been given notice of the application (except where notice is dispensed with in accordance with rules of court), and (b) has been afforded an opportunity to make representations to the county court or sheriff

section-143-3.TO: include provision in respect of a period before the making of the order

section-146-1.TO: make a complaint to an employment tribunal that a term is void, or that a rule is unenforceable, as a result of section 145

section-146-3.TO: make an order declaring that the term is void or the rule is unenforceable
section-146-3.IF: it finds that the complaint is well-founded

section-146-4.TO: include provision in respect of a period before the making of the order
